document.abstract: Note: Some aspects of the subject as presented here do not fit the usual content of Journal papers; however, the combination of engineering and practical matters has favored publication. Sound mixing for nontheatrical and television films can be accomplished with a variety of equipment with adaptations and combinations now feasible. These possible arrangements and their effectiveness are described and evaluated.
